ETH trading volume surpasses BTC: the most honest money flow vote of the weekend

On Sunday’s midday session, the market was so quiet you could hear the sound of transaction fees hitting accounts. BTC was pinned in a tight range of 77,025 to 77,477. 77,179 was hanging on the screen—everyone watching looked like they were about to fall asleep.

But in the quiet, there was a plain truth: ETH’s 24-hour trading volume is 3.26 billion, while BTC is only 3.03 billion. ETH overtook it. Weekend capital isn’t inactive—it’s just changed rooms.

Break it down:
BTC down 0.009%—basically no movement;
ETH up 0.299%—the toughest among the majors;
BNB down 1.005%—726 is right by the daily buy area around 722, but the money doesn’t even look at it;
XRP up 0.066%—purely just running along.

Funding rates: BTC 0.0084%, ETH 0.0095%. What level is this called? It’s called “nobody’s getting overexcited.” Leverage isn’t crowded, and there’s no stacked liquidation wall overhead. If you want to lift the sedan, there aren’t stones in the road.

No new catalysts over the weekend, so the direction can only grow out of the chart itself. What the chart currently says is: moderately bullish—led by ETH.

BTC has only two key levels: the pivot point 77,248 sitting overhead. If it holds and then breaks above 77,471, this low-volume consolidation range is basically the crouch before takeoff; on the other hand, if 77,019 can’t be held, then my bullish call is invalid on the spot—I won’t be stubborn.

ETH is even more straightforward: the floor is 2506, the ceiling 2544. Now 2519 is just below the pivot at 2526, building up energy. ETH’s strength isn’t shouted—it’s built block by block with a 3.26 billion trading volume.

Tongue-in-cheek reminder: during a sideways range, the most expensive cost isn’t floating losses—it’s entering heavy before the direction has flashed its ticket. In a low-volume market, watching which side breaks first between 77,471 and 77,019 is a hundred times more advanced than guessing the top or the bottom.

Bottom line: data leans bullish—ETH leads the charge. Before BTC stands above 77,471, make your position size match your patience.

ETH成交额反超BTC：周末最诚实的一次资金投票

周日午盘，行情安静得能听见手续费到账的声音。BTC被压在77025到77477的窄框里，77179挂在屏幕上，看盘的都快睡着了。

但安静里藏了一句实话：ETH 24小时成交额32.6亿，BTC只有30.3亿。ETH反超了。周末的资金不休息，它们只是换了房间。

拆开看：
BTC跌0.009%，等于没动；
ETH涨0.299%，主流里最硬；
BNB跌1.005%，726贴着日线买点722，资金看都不看一眼；
XRP涨0.066%，纯陪跑。

资金费率：BTC 0.0084%，ETH 0.0095%。这个水平叫什么？叫没人上头。杠杆不拥挤，上方没有堆积的清算墙，想抬轿子，路上没石头。

周末没有新催化剂，方向只能从盘面自己长出来。目前盘面写的是：偏多，ETH领衔。

BTC关键位就两个：轴点77248压在头顶，站稳它、再过77471，这波缩量横盘就是起跳前的下蹲；反过来，77019守不住，我这条偏多判断当场作废，绝不嘴硬。

ETH更干脆：地板2506，天花板2544，现在2519卡在轴点2526下方蓄力。ETH的强不是喊出来的，是32.6亿成交额一块一块垒出来的。

毒舌提醒：横盘期最贵的成本不是浮亏，是方向没亮牌就重仓进场。缩量行情里，盯着77471和77019哪边先破，比猜顶猜底高级一百倍。

结论：数据偏多，ETH打头阵。BTC站上77471之前，让仓位配得上你的耐心。
